<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.video-card').forEach(card => {
  const video = card.querySelector('video');
  // Click = open lightbox
  card.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const src = video.getAttribute('src');
    openVideoLightbox(src);
  });
});

function openVideoLightbox(src) {
  const lightbox = document.createElement('div');
  lightbox.className = 'video-lightbox';
  lightbox.innerHTML = `
    <button class="close-btn" aria-label="Close">×</button>
    <video src="${src}" autoplay controls playsinline></video>
  `;
  document.body.appendChild(lightbox);

  // Close on click or escape
  lightbox.querySelector('.close-btn').addEventListener('click', () => lightbox.remove());
  lightbox.addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (e.target === lightbox) lightbox.remove();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') lightbox.remove();
  });
}
</script>
<script>
jQuery(function($) {

    let currentStep = 1;
    const $steps = $('.step-item');
    const totalSteps = $steps.length;

    // Initialize first step as active
    updateSteps();

    // NEXT button
    $(document).on('click', 'button[aria-busy="false"]', function() {
        if (currentStep < totalSteps) {
            currentStep++;
            updateSteps();

            // Show the bottom-content div when we reach step 3
            if (currentStep === 3) {
                $('.bottom-content').fadeIn(); // Show the div
            }
        }
    });

    // BACK button
    $(document).on('click', 'button:not([aria-busy])', function() {
        if (currentStep > 1) {
            // remove active from current step
            $steps.filter('[data-step="'+ currentStep +'"]').removeClass('active');
            currentStep--;
            
            // Hide the bottom-content div if going back from step 3
            if (currentStep !== 3) {
                $('.bottom-content').fadeOut(); // Hide the div
            }
        }
    });

    // Function to update step active states
    function updateSteps() {
        $steps.each(function() {
            const stepNum = $(this).data('step');
            if (stepNum <= currentStep) {
                $(this).addClass('active'); // keep previous steps active
            }
        });
    }
     $(document).on('click', 'button[type="submit"]', function() {
       // Optionally prevent the form from submitting if you want to handle via AJAX
       //e.preventDefault();

       // Hide the bottom-content and steps-progress-bar
       $('.bottom-content').fadeOut();
       $('.step-progress-bar').fadeOut();
     });
});
</script>

<script>
  console.log("Flieber script carregado.");

  function redirectToFlieber(params) {
    var base = "https://app.flieber.com/sign-up";
    var url = params && params.toString()
      ? base + "?" + params.toString()
      : base;

    console.log("Redirecionando para:", url);
    window.location.href = url;
  }

  window.addEventListener(
    "hs-form-event:on-submission:success",
    function (event) {
      console.log("Evento recebido:", event);

      // tentativa 1: acessar HubSpotFormsV4
      try {
        if (typeof HubSpotFormsV4 === "undefined") {
          console.log("HubSpotFormsV4 nao encontrado. Indo para fallback...");
          redirectToFlieber(null);
          return;
        }

        var form = HubSpotFormsV4.getFormFromEvent(event);
        if (!form) {
          console.log("Form nao encontrado via HubSpotFormsV4. Fallback...");
          redirectToFlieber(null);
          return;
        }

        form
          .getFormFieldValues()
          .then(function (fields) {
            console.log("Campos capturados:", fields);

            if (!Array.isArray(fields) || fields.length === 0) {
              console.log("Nenhum campo retornado. Fallback...");
              redirectToFlieber(null);
              return;
            }

            var email = "";
            var firstName = "";
            var lastName = "";
            var company = "";
            var website = "";

            fields.forEach(function (field) {
              // nomes vêm como "0-1/email"
              var nameParts = field.name.split("/");
              var name = nameParts.length > 1 ? nameParts[1] : field.name;

              if (name === "email") email = field.value;
              if (name === "firstname") firstName = field.value;
              if (name === "lastname") lastName = field.value;
              if (name === "company") company = field.value;
              if (name === "website") website = field.value;
            });

            var params = new URLSearchParams();
            if (email) params.set("email", email);
            if (firstName) params.set("firstname", firstName);
            if (lastName) params.set("lastname", lastName);
            if (company) params.set("company", company);
            if (website) params.set("website", website);

            // se nenhum campo foi extraído
            if ([email, firstName, lastName, company, website].every(v => !v)) {
              console.log("Campos vazios. Fallback...");
              redirectToFlieber(null);
              return;
            }

            redirectToFlieber(params);
          })
          .catch(function (err) {
            console.error("Erro ao ler campos:", err);
            redirectToFlieber(null);
          });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Erro inesperado:", err);
        redirectToFlieber(null);
      }
    }
  );
</script>

<style>
.explainer-videos-new .carousel .video-card {
    box-shadow: none;
}
.carousel .video-card .play-toggle {
    left: 0;
    transform: none;
    top: 0;
}
.video-card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* No shadow, center icon */
.video-card .play-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  border: none;
  color: white;
  font-size: 64px;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
  z-index: 3;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Hover effect */
.video-card:hover .play-toggle {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* When playing, hide icon (still shows on hover) */
.video-card.playing .play-toggle {
  opacity: 0;
}
.video-card.playing:hover .play-toggle {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Lightbox overlay */
.video-lightbox {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  z-index: 9999;
}
.video-lightbox video {
  max-width: 90%;
  max-height: 80vh;
}
.video-lightbox .close-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 30px;
  background: none;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  font-size: 32px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
